Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
After being blocked
After the combat from the block
You play a hidden Lurker with an unlocked vampire
You have a new combat

You are still in the window "after a combat between the acting minion you control and a blocking minion" from the first combat.

You can still play another hidden Lurker with another vampire.

Correct?

Hidden Lurker

Name: Hidden Lurker
[Jyhad:C, VTES:C, SW:C, CE:U, KMW:PAn4]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Obfuscate
Only usable by a ready unlocked vampire other than the acting minion. Only usable after a combat between the acting minion you control and a blocking minion.
[obf] Lock this vampire. This vampire enters combat with the blocking minion. The first round of this new combat, the blocking minion cannot strike.
[OBF] As above, with an optional press.
Artist: Steve Casper

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
Based on card text I would say no...after the combat that was triggered from the first Hidden Lurker you wouldn't be able to meet the requirement

"Only usable after a combat between the acting minion you control and a blocking minion"

because it would now not be after a combat between the acting and the blocker but after a combat between a non-acting and the blocker.

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
Found this  ruling that supports the above.

> LSJ wrote:
> > If I block and play Blissful Agony (superior) during the combat
> > can the acting minion's controller follow up with a Hidden Lurker?
> No.
> Hidden Lurker can only be played after a combat between the acting
> minion and a blocking minion.
> The Blissful Agony combat is not such a combat (unless you do a lot of
> other card gymnastics in there to make it such a combat, in which case
> card text on HL will be met, so HL could be played).
>

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
I see I never had an official answer about this

I will clarify one point. I am not queuing two combats.

After being blocked
After the combat from the block
You play a hidden Lurker with an unlocked vampire
You have a new combat
After this second combat is over...
¿Can another unlocked minion you control play another hidden Lurker and start another combat with the blocking vampire?

Time-wise and language-wise it is still "after a combat between the acting minion you control and a blocking minion"

Game-wise I feel the window "after a combat between the acting minion you control and a blocking minion" is closed right at the moment the first combat from Hidden Lurker starts.

This question raised thinking about The Guardian and the use of Freak Drive.
I understand that the acting bleeding minion can only play Freak Drive before the combat. I think that "after action resolution" window is closed right at the moment the combat with the guardian started. So a freak drive could not be played after the combat. Although technically it is "after action resolution"

This question is to understand better when windows are opened and closed.
And I think the question is

After another events queues, does the previous windows get closed?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
That is kinda contradictory and is what I am trying to figure out.

First I want to clarify that, when I say play a second Hidden Lurker, it is not activated by the combat of the first Hidden Lurker, but because I argue if it is still in the window from the first blocked combat.

Case A. Hidden Lurker

"after a combat" window starts after the end of a combat. And this window should end right before "After resolution" window start.

So Vampire A is blocked by vampire X. Vampire A combats blocking vampire X and ends. Window "after a combat" for Hidden Lurker starts. Vampire B plays Hidden Lurker and start a combat with X. Combat ends. The window "after a combat" (the window from combat between A and blocking X) is still not closed. So a Vampire C could play a Hidden Lurker to combat with vampire X. No because he has fought vampire B but because previously he blocked and combated vampire A.  If it can't, I want to understand why the window is closed.

Case B. The guardian and Freak Drive

"After resolution" window starts after blocked combat (and its subsequent combats in case of psyche and similar) are handled or after resolute/fizzle of the action if not blocked. That is why freak drive can be (and must be) played after combats FROM BLOCKING.

The guardian is different as it queues a combat not during the blocking resolution but after the resolution of the action. When the window "After resolution" has already started.

So. When a window ends/get closed?
If the window of Hidden Lurker gets closed when the combat from Hidden Lurker starts and avoids playing second Hidden Lurker after the first combat, why the window "after resolution" can span even after a combat from The guardian?

I feel this is contradictory, and mainly because I feel it is not clear when some windows are closed.

No, this is long passed.
"after" means "immediately after"

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
Thank you.

That helps a lot.

I understand that it always applies. So you can't play a Freak Drive after you had a combat with The guardian, caused by its ability to enter combat against a minion after a successful bleed. If you wish to play a Freak Drive, it should be right after the successful bleed and before entering in combat by The Guardian. Not just some moment after a successful bleed.

So from now I will read "after" as "immediately after". That makes sense and a lot clearer.
